runx-cli.decision: Keep Apache-2.0. The OSS CLI does not perform hosted connect brokerage or private payment execution.

runx-contracts.decision: Provider-neutral contracts and credential-delivery envelope stay Apache-2.0.

runx-contracts-derive.decision: Provider-neutral schema derivation stays Apache-2.0; no brokerage or provider calls.

runx-core.decision: Policy and authority enforcement stay Apache-2.0; no brokerage or provider calls.

runx-js-worker.decision: The resource-bounded deterministic JavaScript worker stays Apache-2.0; it has no host or provider capabilities.

runx-runtime.decision: Keep Apache-2.0. Runtime owns local credential consumption, resolved delivery, process supervision, and redaction only.

runx-sdk.decision: Keep Apache-2.0. Hosted connect-list APIs are not exposed from the OSS SDK.

runx-x402.decision: Effect-free x402 v2 presentation and Runx invocation binding stay Apache-2.0; provider verification, settlement, credentials, and rails remain outside this crate.

private_home.notes: Private broker for hosted provider OAuth, hosted connect HTTP, BYO custody, grant issuance, and grant revocation.

payment_private_home.notes: Private payment admission, provider SDKs, rails, reservations, ledgers, refunds, recovery, and finality.

allowlist.rationale: Boundary guard negative-case assertion for a copied excluded fixture.

private_move_or_abstract.rationale: Hosted OAuth polling and RUNX_CONNECT_ACCESS_TOKEN brokerage.
Provider gateway OAuth state and connection_id typed surfaces.
Browser opener for hosted connect flow.
Module root currently re-exports hosted brokerage.
Public hosted connect re-exports must be removed or replaced.
The native client may call the generic grant and provider-operation contract; OAuth custody and provider brokerage remain private in Cloud.
Connect command routing must not invoke hosted brokerage.
SDK connect-list and connection_id surface is hosted-private.
